ELITE: NEXT for PSP
===================

Play this build on a real PSP or in PPSSPP.
Updates: https://github.com/roodmilk/elite-next-psp/releases/latest

Install — PPSSPP
  1. Open EBOOT.PBP from this folder in PPSSPP
     (Games → Load file…).
  2. Prefer 480x272 or an integer scale (2x / 3x).

Install — real PSP
  1. Copy this entire folder to the Memory Stick as:
       ms0:/PSP/GAME/ELITE-NEXT/
  2. EBOOT.PBP must sit directly inside that folder.
  3. Launch ELITE: NEXT from the Game menu
     (homebrew-capable firmware required).

Custom music (optional)
  Put MP3 files into the matching folder under music/.
  The game scans folders at startup and shuffles the
  selected station. Restart after adding or removing tracks.

  Do not rename the five station folders:
    Deep Field, Neon Transit, Pixel Comet,
    Velvet Orbit, Far Horizons
